companyDescription: Biotech · Bispecific antibody platform (zanidatamab/Ziihera) partnered with Jazz Pharmaceuticals — milestone + royalty stream on an oncology franchise expanding from 2L biliary tract cancer into 1L gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma
priceNote: Up 2.3% intraday, still well off the 52-week high of $29.75, recovering from the Aug 6 Q2 earnings miss (EPS -$0.62 vs -$0.37 est., revenue $4.6M vs $19.1M est.) as the market looks past the small BTC commercial base toward the Aug 25 GEA-label PDUFA decision.
summary: Zymeworks' zanidatamab (marketed as Ziihera, partnered with Jazz Pharmaceuticals) already has FDA approval in 2nd-line HER2+ biliary tract cancer since Nov 2024. The Aug 25, 2026 PDUFA date is for a supplemental BLA adding first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEA) — a much larger population — backed by a positive Phase 3 (HERIZON-GEA-01: median PFS 12.4 vs 8.1 months, HR 0.63, p<.0001) and Priority Review status. Approval unlocks a $250M US milestone (of $440M total) plus a materially bigger royalty base, but the Q2 revenue miss shows the current BTC business alone is still thin, and the payout flows through Jazz as milestones/royalties, not full commercial upside.

catalysts.name: Zanidatamab 1L GEA PDUFA Decision
catalysts.description: FDA target action date for the sBLA (filed by partner Jazz Pharmaceuticals) adding first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma to the label. Priority Review was granted on positive Phase 3 HERIZON-GEA-01 data (median PFS 12.4mo vs 8.1mo, HR 0.63, p<.0001; median OS >2 years). Approval unlocks a $250M US regulatory milestone (part of $440M total) plus a much larger addressable population than the existing 2L BTC indication.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings (reported)
catalysts.description: Reported Aug 6, 2026: EPS -$0.62 missed estimate by $0.25, revenue $4.6M vs $19.1M consensus — a real miss. Despite that, Citi raised its target to $37 (from $35) and kept Buy, reading the miss as noise against the PDUFA setup.

risks: Even with Priority Review and a strong Phase 3 readout, an FDA CRL or label restriction remains possible — binary regulatory risk is never zero
Q2 revenue miss ($4.6M actual vs $19.1M est.) shows the current commercial BTC indication is still small — the thesis leans heavily on the GEA expansion actually landing on schedule

Approval economics flow through Jazz Pharmaceuticals as milestones + tiered royalties, not full commercial control — Zymeworks captures only part of eventual GEA revenue, capping upside vs a wholly-owned approval
Thin trading liquidity (~$1.75B cap, ~250K shares/day recent volume) means the PDUFA reaction — good or bad — can gap sharply with limited ability to exit near the last quoted price

estimateDates.note: FDA target action date, Priority Review — positive Phase 3 data (HR 0.63, p<.0001) already public
Next scheduled financial update, after the PDUFA decision

analystTargets.note: Raised from $35 on Aug 7, 2026 despite the Q2 revenue miss, ahead of the Aug 25 PDUFA
Midpoint of the cited $31 (low) – $58 (high) analyst target range

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026, but 3 of 12 officials dissented in favor of a hike — the most hawkish dissent split since 2016. Next FOMC is Sep 15-16, 2026, after this PDUFA. CPI prints Aug 12, 2026, sits directly between this report and the Aug 25 decision and could move risk appetite for small-cap biotech financing broadly.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE still running 3.3% YoY, above the Fed's 2% target — a hot Aug 12 CPI could trigger a broad risk-off move in small/micro-cap biotech (rate-sensitive sector via financing costs) independent of ZYME's own binary outcome.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Small-cap clinical/commercial biotech is more sensitive to risk-appetite swings than idiosyncratic FDA-driven names would suggest — a hawkish CPI surprise before Aug 25 could compress the stock's pre-PDUFA run-up regardless of the underlying approval odds.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the approval decision itself is idiosyncratic and largely macro-independent, but the CPI print (Aug 12) lands squarely in the run-up window and a hawkish surprise could dampen the sector-wide biotech risk appetite this specific trade depends on for its pre-catalyst positioning.

entryStrategy.verdict: SPECULATIVE (Buy the binary) — Priority Review + a statistically strong Phase 3 (HR 0.63, p<.0001) lowers approval risk versus a typical first-in-class biotech bet, but the Jazz-partnered royalty structure caps direct upside and a CRL is never zero-probability. Small, sized-for-binary-risk position into Aug 25.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Priority-Review PDUFA setups typically see a 4-8 week pre-decision run-up as positioning builds ahead of the binary. ZYME has partly followed this pattern off its 52-week low ($10.93), but the Aug 6 earnings miss interrupted the run-up, so less is 'priced in' heading into Aug 25 than a clean Priority Review setup would normally show.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 4–8 weeks before PDUFA (since late June/early July 2026), interrupted by the Aug 6 earnings miss
catalystSpot.preRunupPct: +20% to +40% is the general Priority-Review pattern; ZYME's own run has been choppier given the earnings miss

postWin.note: Approval on an already-partnered, already-marketed drug tends toward the muted end of the typical 30-200% first-approval range, since much is already priced in. ZYME's own 2024 BTC approval barely moved the stock (-8% same-day, alongside an earnings release); Omeros' first-in-class approval in Aug 2026 added only +8% premarket.

postLose.note: No direct ZYME-specific CRL precedent exists to cite — this is the general pattern for Priority-Review oncology sBLAs with strong Phase 3 data that still receive a CRL or restrictive label; the surprise factor amplifies the reaction versus a name where rejection was already expected.
postLose.exampleDate: N/A — general oncology PDUFA/CRL pattern, no ZYME-specific prior case

spotSizing.reason: Binary PDUFA event on a $1.75B-cap name with real CRL tail risk — even with Priority Review and strong Phase 3 data, this is sized like a speculative/ค่าขนม position, not a core holding

stopPreCatalyst.note: A break below $20-21 before Aug 25 signals the market is pricing in real rejection risk — exit before the binary if this level breaks

stopPostCatalyst.note: If approved but the stock still sells off past -25% (e.g. a narrow/restricted label), the 'clean broad approval' thesis has failed even though the drug technically cleared

comparableCases.note: Same drug's first FDA approval — the stock fell ~8% the day it was announced (alongside Q4 results) because accelerated approval was already largely expected. Direct precedent for why the Aug 25 GEA sBLA approval may not produce a large pop even if it clears.

comparableCases.event: Yartemlea first-in-class FDA approval (rare transplant complication)
comparableCases.note: Recent same-window example: even a genuine first-of-its-kind approval only produced a modest +8% premarket pop — approvals well-telegraphed by Priority Review status tend to already be partly priced in before the decision date.

th.summary: Zanidatamab ของ Zymeworks (ชื่อการค้า Ziihera ร่วมกับพาร์ทเนอร์ Jazz Pharmaceuticals) ได้รับอนุมัติ FDA ไปแล้วสำหรับมะเร็งท่อน้ำดี HER2+ แนวที่ 2 ตั้งแต่ พ.ย. 2024 ส่วนวันที่ 25 ส.ค. 2026 คือ PDUFA ของ sBLA ที่ขอขยาย label ไปยังมะเร็งกระเพาะ/หลอดอาหาร HER2+ แนวที่ 1 (GEA) — กลุ่มผู้ป่วยใหญ่กว่ามาก โดยมีข้อมูล Phase 3 บวก (HERIZON-GEA-01: PFS กลาง 12.4 vs 8.1 เดือน, HR 0.63, p<.0001) และได้ Priority Review การอนุมัติจะปลดล็อก milestone $250M (จากทั้งหมด $440M) และฐาน royalty ที่ใหญ่ขึ้นมาก แต่ผลประกอบการ Q2 ที่พลาดคาดแสดงว่าธุรกิจ BTC ปัจจุบันยังเล็ก และรายได้ไหลผ่าน Jazz เป็น milestone/royalty ไม่ใช่กำไรเต็มจำนวน

macroRisk.summary: ปานกลาง — ผลการตัดสินของ FDA เป็นเรื่องเฉพาะบริษัทและค่อนข้าง macro-independent แต่ตัวเลข CPI (12 ส.ค.) ตกอยู่ในช่วงก่อนตัดสินพอดี hawkish surprise อาจลดทอน risk appetite ของ biotech ที่ trade นี้ต้องพึ่งพาสำหรับการไต่ระดับราคาก่อนวันตัดสิน
